item.title: Cabinet Order Adjusting Related Orders for Partial Enforcement of the Amendment to the Pharmaceuticals and Medical...
item.description: AI summary: This item concerns a Cabinet Order that adjusts related government orders in connection with the partial enforcement of a law amending the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, and Other Products (PMD Act). According to the metadata, the amending Cabinet Order is numbered Reiwa 8 Cabinet Order No. 210, with a promulgation date of 2026-06-24 and an enforcement date of 2027-05-20. The metadata also references the Local Autonomy Act Enforcement Order (Showa 22 Cabinet Order No. 16) as an affected instrument. item.title: Public Comment: Draft Designation of Pharmaceuticals by the MHLW Minister under Article 68-2(1) of the PMD Act
item.description: AI summary: This is a public comment invitation on a draft designating pharmaceuticals to be specified by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare under Article 68-2, paragraph 1 of Japan's Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (PMD Act). According to the metadata, the draft was posted on 2026-09-11 with a comment submission deadline of 2026-10-10. The inquiry contact is listed as the Pharmaceutical Safety Division of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Bureau.
